definition: Gemini Robotics is an advanced vision–language–action model developed by Google DeepMind.
details: It is based on the Gemini 2.0 large language model. It is tailored for robotics applications and can understand new situations. There is a related version called Gemini Robotics–ER, which stands for embodied reasoning. The two models were launched on March 12, 2025. On June 24, 2025, Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics On-Device, a variant designed and optimized to run locally on robotic devices. On July 30, 2026, Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics ER 2, an upgrade to its embodied reasoning model featuring real-time video understanding, task progress tracking, lower-latency orchestration via the Gemini Live API, tool integration, and multi-robot collaboration. With this release, the model was made publicly available to developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Access to earlier Gemini Robotics models was initially restricted to trusted testers, including Agile Robots, Agility Robotics, Boston Dynamics, and Enchanted Tools.

explainer.lead: Gemini Robotics is Google DeepMind’s vision–language–action model for helping robots interpret situations and act on instructions. Its family also includes models for embodied reasoning and local operation on robotic devices, connecting task understanding with robot deployment.

tiers.eli5: A robot brain that sees, reads instructions, and moves, so it can handle situations it wasn't specifically taught.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to connect perception and language to robot actions, with an on-device variant for local execution. A pitfall is assuming the cloud and on-device versions are interchangeable.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, Gemini Robotics is a vision–language–action model derived from Gemini 2.0; the related Gemini Robotics–ER handles embodied reasoning. Known limits follow from its basis on Gemini 2.0 and the capabilities of each variant.

components.name: Gemini 2.0: the underlying large language model.
Gemini Robotics: the vision–language–action model for robotics.
Gemini Robotics–ER: the related embodied-reasoning version.
On-Device: a variant optimized for local robot execution.
ER 2: an upgraded reasoning model with video, tracking, orchestration, tools, and multi-robot collaboration.

flow: Visual and language information describes the robot’s situation and task.
Gemini 2.0 supplies the underlying model foundation.
Gemini Robotics connects that understanding to robot action.
Related variants specialize in embodied reasoning or local execution.
explainer.origin: Google DeepMind launched Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics–ER on March 12, 2025. It released Gemini Robotics On-Device on June 24, 2025.
explainer.lineage: The original model is based on Gemini 2.0, with Gemini Robotics–ER as its embodied-reasoning counterpart. Announced on July 30, 2026, ER 2 upgraded that line and became publicly available to developers through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
explainer.whyItMatters: The family brings vision, language, action, and embodied reasoning together for robots that must handle unfamiliar situations. Its on-device and developer-accessible variants also address two practical concerns: running locally on robots and making the technology available beyond the initial trusted-testing group.
